E6 also shows gold prefix alive at depth 4 only 0.068-0.088 for every arm, so a fourth token is hard for Stage 3.

(6) CGREP-4L-RQ pushes through q_i over all levels (coarse-partition risk), adds a low-survival fourth token, and its +0.7104 behaviour-contrast correlation is not in the bundle. RANK: BCMID-L3-RQ | position=1 | reason=E6/E8 show the coarse levels are better kept small (K=16/64 preserve behavioural neighbours far more often than 256) and the capacity loss is exactly at depth (1.24 L3 codes per L2 pair), and this is the only candidate that expands L3 alone, leaves L1/L2 at 256, uses the E9-validated successor-profile signal with popularity centred out, and never moves item points, so it cannot repeat the round-one/two merge.
RANK: HYSPLIT-BEHV-RQ | position=2 | reason=same E6/E8 evidence favours a 3-token deep-only refinement, and doubling the deepest codebook with a spacing-capped offset directly targets the measured deep-prefix-capacity correlate (2201 L3 prefixes at 0.0544 vs 1298 at 0.0517) while avoiding the 0.068-0.088 depth-4 beam survival of E6; below BCMID because its asymmetry buffer can be near zero and leave one child unused. RANK: BEHDIR-L4 | position=3 | reason=it keeps L1-L3 bit-identical (so the 2201-prefix capacity cannot fall) and derives s0 from the measured residual and K4 from the 10% distance budget, but E6 (depth-4 alive 0.068-0.088) and E7 (fourth-position NLL is where generation fails) make the added token the weak link.
RANK: GYRO-BEHAFF-SID | position=4 | reason=it is the only proposal that mechanically repairs the measured near-zero L3 residual with gyro-subtraction and the (1-a) multiplier is a real behaviour-geometry argmin, but E8's coarse-K curve (256 -> 0.0822 vs 64 -> 0.1547) warns that doubling L2 to 512 fragments the coherence prefix survival depends on, and a=1 can zero the geometric term.
RANK: BISECT-L4-ASYM | position=5 | reason=the additive L4 preserves the working three-level partition and raises distinct deep SIDs, but behaviour enters only as a scalar asymmetry weight over ~5-item quantiles (E5 shows low-entropy support 2.8, so b_i is sparse/fallback) and E6's 0.068-0.088 depth-4 survival caps the payoff.
RANK: CGREP-4L-RQ | position=6 | reason=reversing attraction is motivated by the merge evidence, but the push acts through q_i over all four levels and so perturbs the coarse partition E6/E8 show is working, the fourth token inherits the low depth-4 survival, and the +0.7104 behaviour-contrast correlation it relies on is absent from the frozen bundle.
RANK: HOLO-TILT-L3 | position=7 | reason=E6 and every proposal's own diagnosis put the L3 residual near zero, so rotating a near-zero vector by ~45-50 degrees cannot create the missing separation while it injects item-specific noise into a shared codebook, and doubling L2 to 512 also contradicts E8; this one is last because its geometry is inert on the stated collapse and disruptive to the coarse cells.
